column1: # Expected import edges for the bindings trap fixture (js-ts).
# from<TAB>to, one per line. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly:
# a missing line is an edge the extractor stopped finding, an extra line
# is an edge it invented. Both are regressions.
# Written from the fixture sources alone, by an independent oracle that
# never saw the extractor or its output; the two are reconciled separately.
# src/barrel.cjs: module.exports = on line 3, require("./lib/b") on line 4.
# src/lib/external.ts has no edge: every specifier is a package not in the tree.
# src/lib/string-decoy.ts has no edge: its require(/import( text is inside strings.
# src/lib/evil.ts, evil.js and evil2.ts import nothing and nothing imports them.
# src/lib/a.js, cfg.js, page.js are stubs; ./a, ./cfg, ./page land on them (no .ts twin).
# src/lib/destructure-default.ts: a require used as a destructuring default is a real edge.
# src/route-a.ts and src/route-b.ts reach src/lib/b.ts twice (./lib/b and @lib/b): one edge each.
# src/Report.vue: only the <script> import counts, not the template text.
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
